spans.text: These Terms & Conditions apply to the TV PDF Viewer application for Roku devices and Roku TV devices (the "Application"). The Application is provided by Deepak PK (the "Service Provider") as a local PDF-viewing utility for reading PDF documents on a TV through a same-Wi-Fi browser connection.
By downloading, installing, or using the Application on a Roku device, you agree to these Terms & Conditions.

The Application is intended to help you view PDF documents on your TV. You connect a phone, tablet, or computer browser on the same Wi-Fi network, choose PDF files in that browser, and the browser sends document metadata, thumbnails, rendered page images, and rendered zoomed page regions to the Roku device for display.
You are responsible for the PDF files you choose to open and for making sure you have the right to view, use, display, or search those documents.
